title: The Sock Sled
sentences: Jill and Jo had a big sock and a doll.
In the play, the sock was a sled.
Jo put the doll in it.
The doll fit snug in the sock.
Jill set the sock on a rug.
She got the cuff and gave it a pull.
The sock went with a swish.
Jo got the cuff and gave it a pull.
The sock did a spin on the rug.
The doll was still snug in the sock.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What did the sock do after Jo gave it a pull?
